verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a REST API, an OpenAPI 3.1 schema that developers can use to generate typed clients, and per-language code examples built on raw HTTP clients such as Java HttpClient. None of this documents an official, published SDK package. A schema and sample code are developer building blocks or adjacent material, not the SDK itself, so the applicable axis stays at none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
